timing: before DataSTOC response values are fetched or inspected for EOG-WF
reason: The two STOC periods provide period-specific environmental predictors. A fair temporal forecast must let both EOG-WF and external SDMs use heldout-period predictors while freezing every threshold and transformation on calibration-period inputs only.

world_time_rule.geography: site coordinates are fixed; pairwise Haversine distances are the same in both periods
world_time_rule.environment_scaling: fit calibration-period mean and population SD on the six predictors; apply unchanged to both periods
world_time_rule.threshold_freeze: geographic and environmental threshold values are computed only from calibration-period inputs
world_time_rule.calibration_operator: build each of the fixed 20 world graphs using calibration-period environmental distances
world_time_rule.heldout_operator: build the same 20 world IDs using the same frozen threshold values but heldout-period environmental distances
world_time_rule.world_identity: world ID denotes the frozen threshold/family rule, not a byte-identical adjacency matrix across time
world_time_rule.reconstruction: world survival is determined only on the calibration operator using the frozen anchor/compatibility rule
world_time_rule.forecast: for each world that survives calibration, compute heldout horizon-8 support on that world's heldout operator from the same frozen calibration anchors

feature_time_rule.frequency_model_train_features: support frequency derived from surviving calibration operators
feature_time_rule.frequency_model_heldout_features: support frequency derived from the corresponding surviving heldout operators
feature_time_rule.identity_model_train_features: ordered support bits from surviving calibration operators
feature_time_rule.identity_model_heldout_features: ordered support bits from the corresponding surviving heldout operators
feature_time_rule.external_logistic_and_rf: fit on calibration-period predictor rows and responses; predict heldout-period rows using the unchanged fitted models

forbidden_after_response_open: choose whether to use calibration or heldout environment after observing response
drop period-varying predictors because they hurt one method
change the world IDs between periods
